workflow. Source preparation grants no execution authority. Root must first
verify the frozen new controller and allocate ONE new hosted producer and
ordinary artifact handoff; the old local producer and SDK allocations are spent.
No dispatch, provisioning, signing, compilation or artifact upload ran during
source preparation. No ONE-Q clock/source repair is imported here.

guard selects only `codex/experimental-native-q-host-package-mini505-p11`.
